title: HB171 (2026 Regular): Criminal Law - Drug Trafficking Crime - Definition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2026RS/bills/hb/hb0171f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader as filed; no vote on record. The firearm offence in § 5-621(b)-(c) (5-year mandatory minimum) is unchanged existing law; the bill only widens the definition it uses. Counted as one subject under the ruling on gun-act crimes.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Criminal Law § 5-621(a)(2)): “Drug trafficking crime” means: (I) a felony or a conspiracy to commit a felony involving the possession, distribution, manufacture, or importation of a controlled dangerous substance under §§ 5–602 through 5–609 and 5–614 of this subtitle; OR (II) A MISDEMEANOR OR A CONSPIRACY TO COMMIT A MISDEMEANOR IN VIOLATION OF § 5–602(B)(1) OR § 5–603(B) OF THIS SUBTITLE.
